marketing_description: The NUVO® Direct Wire Downlight (part 62-1875) delivers 2000 lm from a single 75 W LED (E26) while drawing only 10.8‑11.3 W at 120 V, 1/5 A, 60 Hz. Available in five color temperatures from 2700 K to 5000 K with CRI 90+, the round baffle trim and frosted polycarbonate lens provide even illumination in a 10‑in ceiling opening, and the fixture is dimmable, air‑tight, IC rated, and includes a remote driver. Constructed of steel with a white finish, the ceiling‑mounted unit meets IP20 requirements.
